## Independent reviewer reproduction

```powershell
$env:NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED = '1'
$env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE = '1'
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/mandate-authorization.test.ts
corepack pnpm run ci
py -3 -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p "test_*.py" -v
git diff --check
git status --short --branch
```

Pass means the focused suite reports 6/6, full CI reports 111/111 across 14 files and exits `0`, governance reports 7/7, diff check has no errors, and only the 19 documented Prompt 15 plus Prompt 14 acceptance-reconciliation paths are changed. Passing does not mark PB2-15 ACCEPTED.

## Diff summary

The change replaces mandate-case and implementation JSON envelopes with canonical typed owners, adds four distinct atomic mandate transitions, and adds an opt-in fixture-only authorization resolver at the existing source step. It makes missing production law a visible blocker, forbids unlisted institutional grantors, preserves negotiated scope/integrity state, and keeps implementation behind a separate authorized command. It adds no production legal authority, consent inference, real actor position, balance formula or automatic implementation dynamic.
